edit.description: `LockFamily` (532) publishes the effective kind set — every declared kind by bare name, overlaid built-ins plus every custom row lifted through `CustomKind::from_kind_fact_row` — as a field beside `overlaid_builtin_kinds`, filled from the `all_declared` value `assemble_lock_family` already computes at 1263. The field is the one home; `declared_kinds_with_overlaid` (771) keeps the derivation and loses its other two callers: `resolve_kind_units` (918, counted once per kind by `RESOLVE_KIND_UNITS_COUNT`) rebuilds the whole map inside its `(_, _, None)` arm at 948 — once per kind governing no locus, and each rebuild re-runs `partition_kind_rows` over every kind row — and `build_manifest_cache` (1725) rebuilds it once more per invocation. Both take the hoisted map instead, threaded through `kind_units_and_features` (1043) and `builtin_units_and_features_by_kind` (1078); the compose-internal call at 1280 and the unit test at 2260 read it from scope. The overlaid map stays a field of its own — `builtin_units_and_features_by_kind` (1085) and `gate::committed_member_sites` (gate.rs 95) need the built-in/custom split the merged map does not carry — so this is an addition, not a replacement. The hoist is the sanctioned derivation cache (`engineering.md`, "Derived state is computed": one home, one invalidation), exactly as `overlaid_builtin_kinds`'s own doc (566) already declares for the same reason. New thread-local count beside the three at 39-42 with a `pub fn` accessor in the shape of `overlay_builtin_kind_count` (53), so the once-per-run claim is decidable.

The `LockFamily` destructure (168) is deliberately `..`-free, so the new field lands here as a compile error: bind it and pass it to `build_manifest_cache` (228) and to the two `kind_units_and_features` calls (262, 371) in place of their per-call rebuild.

`explain`'s own destructure (2326) binds the new field through its `..`, and its `build_manifest_cache` (2340) and `builtin_units_and_features_by_kind` (2348) / `kind_units_and_features` (2396) calls take it — the read verb runs the same assembly tier and pays the same rebuilds.

The second caller of `builtin_units_and_features_by_kind`, outside the first scoping's fence and the reason the first build attempt could not land (`.flume/refactor/build-effective-kind-set-fence-misses-nested-member-caller.md`, drained this tick): the `compose_corpus` helper (1437) calls it at 1443 with `&family.overlaid_builtin_kinds, &disc, &family.declarations, &cache`. One line of edit — thread the new field in as the argument the function now takes in place of `&family.declarations`. The arity must change: the function needs both maps (the overlaid one is the built-in/custom split its own loop selects on, the merged one is what each inner `kind_units_and_features` must receive), so no shape preserves the signature except passing the overlaid map where the merged one is expected — a subset correct only for a lock declaring no custom kinds.

The count pin, in the shape of `overlay_builtin_kind_count_increments_once_per_application` (1316): over a harness whose kind set includes a locus-less kind (the embedded set carries two — `supporting-doc` and `handler`, both `governs: None`, builtin_kind.rs 1035 and 1225), a full `check` run derives the declared-kind map exactly once. The vacuity pin rides it (`engineering.md`, "A green verdict is proven non-vacuous"): assert the derived map is non-empty before asserting the count, so a map that collapsed to zero cannot read as a hoisted one. The existing `gate_manifest_cache_read_is_hoisted_across_governing_kinds` (1350) loses its `declarations` fixture (1431) once `build_manifest_cache` stops deriving — its two `KindFactRow`s and the `Declarations` built from them go dead, as do its own function-local `CollectionAddressRow`/`Declarations`/`KindFactRow` imports (1353); the overlaid map it already hands over as the third argument is exactly what the merged parameter wants here, no custom kinds in play. Expected, not lost coverage: that pin is about manifest reads per governing kind, and the kinds now reach it through the map directly.

summary: The effective kind set is a whole-lock derivation rebuilt once per locus-less kind and once per manifest cache; LockFamily publishes the one it already computes.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

tests.asserts: a full `check` run derives the declared-kind map exactly once, asserted after a non-empty check on the map itself; fails on the pre-fix tree at four derivations — the assembly pass, the manifest cache, and one apiece for the two locus-less kinds' own unit resolution — and once more per nested-file or embedded kind a consumer declares

acceptance: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check green; the new count pin green; `rg "declared_kinds_with_overlaid" src/` shows the derivation and exactly one caller.
notes: Posture sweep of the admissibility neighborhood; the census crossed into compose. No field cost report, so no benchmark is owed — the violation is structural (whole-input work recomputed per kind) and its pin is a count, per the cited section. Re-scoped from the refactor channel: the nested_member caller and the real pre-fix count of 4 (not 3) are the first scoping's two misses, both re-verified on disk. scoped at 774a179d
